claim_ceiling: These realization contracts prevent duplicate durable identities. They admit and activate nothing.

entries.realization: Represent each concrete participant through its governed carrier, then classify the exact revision through Classification Scheme, Classification Value, and Classification Assignment.
entries.reason: The admitted Definition explicitly says Actor is an abstract participation classification and does not require one universal Actor carrier.

entries.realization: Represent concrete operation through Agent Instance inside Agent Session, then classify the exact instance through the governed Agent actor-kind Scheme and Assignment.
entries.reason: The admitted Definition explicitly says Agent is an operational Actor classification and concrete operation requires Agent Instance plus Agent Session.

entries.realization: Closed Session Memory schema embedded in Agent Session runtime; persistence is forbidden and no durable Artifact Type instance is permitted.
entries.reason: The Definition makes Session Memory ephemeral, owned by one Session, and expired at termination.

entries.realization: Represent the selected method through Governed Model or Workflow plus its concrete Lesson, Application, Assessment, and Improvement artifacts.
entries.reason: The cycle is a method connecting record types rather than an independently versioned occurrence record.

entries.realization: Classification Scheme defines the contract; Classification Assignment records the governed result; Classification Value supplies allowed answers.
entries.reason: A separate Classification record would duplicate the Assignment identity and result.

entries.realization: Failure Mode defines the possible boundary violation; Failure Occurrence records evidence of an episode; Failure Assessment evaluates it.
entries.reason: A separate Failure artifact would collapse the design-time mode, observed occurrence, and assessment axes.
